CustomField.description: Developer Name of the Report Folder the Live Reports tab lists from (SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Report WHERE FolderName = ...). Visibility of both the folder and each report inside it already follows Salesforce's own folder-sharing + Role Hierarchy -- the app just lists/runs whatever the signed-in user can already see. Left blank means Live Reports has nothing to list.
CustomField.label: Published Reports Folder Name
